searchText: Anyone from team <@&836981603216654336> here to help out with a hive question? I'm updating the older sync tests to work with a post-merge chain and running into difficulties with besu because it still checks the PoW on imported headers when sync is triggered by the engine API, there should be no need to check it because all block hashes are known So I'm hoping there is some kind of internal flag to disable these checks Hey <@194432762315407360> maybe try --skip-pow-validation-enabled <@761154847432769577> it didn't work, unfortunately would you mind sending the genesis config and startup params you are using?
